neighbours.label: Mental traits, moods and well-being named as things a study, scale or clinician measures (anxiety, self-esteem, positive affect, life satisfaction, memory decline), lighting up on the list word or 'in'/'of' just before them; a second trigger is the legal word 'pre-sentence' (report, investigation). Quiet: the same feelings in everyday or diary talk, body measures (blood pressure, glucose, weight), and the plain word 'sentence'.
fire: Participants completed questionnaires assessing anxiety, depression and self-esteem at baseline and twelve weeks.
The intervention produced significant improvements in positive affect and life satisfaction compared with controls.
Clinicians rated changes in mood, irritability and sleep quality using a standardized scale.
We observed a reduction in depressive symptoms and an increase in perceived well-being among older adults.
Secondary outcomes included memory decline, attention and processing speed over two years.
The survey measured loneliness, optimism and psychological distress in first-year students.
Scores on the scale reflect levels of stress, anger and negative affect during the past month.
The judge ordered a pre-sentence report before deciding on the defendant's punishment.
quiet: Endpoints were resting heart rate, grip strength and waist size at month nine.
By one estimate, this burden amounts to $80 billion per year.
I felt anxious all morning, but a long walk by the river helped a lot.
The intervention produced significant improvements in blood pressure and fasting glucose compared with controls.
Clinicians recorded changes in weight, heart rate and cholesterol at each visit.

Secondary outcomes included body mass index, waist circumference and bone density over two years.
The teacher asked us to rewrite the sentence so the verb agreed with its subject.
